AUTHORITY_BASIS: Current explicit user V16-RC1.3 directive enables STATIC_AND_CONTROL_REPAIR before product activation.
V16-RC1.3 [039]-[046] requires monotonic Mission Fence CAS and serialized global transitions.
V16-RC1.3 [169]-[174] permits serialized global fence plus horizontally scaled bulk control state.
V16-RC1.3 [196]-[216] defines closure barrier, membership/drain roots, pinned world, COMPLETE CAS and REOPEN.
V16-RC1.3 [217] requires every Chat to create or renew sharded membership.
The independent V2 review explicitly found the repair law-preserving subject to composition requirements.

CANONICAL_PROTOCOL_RULES.RECORD_CAS_COMPOSITION: Every membership record mutation continues to require EXPECTED_RECORD_GENERATION=N -> N+1 under [079]. Record CAS and the containing shard CAS must succeed as one canonical operation; neither substitutes for the other.
CANONICAL_PROTOCOL_RULES.SHARD_CAS_DOMAIN: Every normal membership mutation and membership-shard freeze transition is serialized in one authoritative CAS domain per logical shard. Frozen shard state increments monotonic SHARD_STATE_VERSION and stale pre-freeze membership writers fail.
CANONICAL_PROTOCOL_RULES.GLOBAL_CLOSURE_CAS: Every Mission Fence closure/reopen/complete mutation obeys [039]-[041] STATE_VERSION expected-version CAS and [042]-[046] transition serialization.
CANONICAL_PROTOCOL_RULES.POST_PIN_MEMBERSHIP_CHANGE: After PINNED_WORLD_READY or later sweep states, any normal membership create/renew/suspend/retire/revoke request must first win an expected-version Mission Fence transition to REOPEN_REQUIRED before its membership write can be admitted.
CANONICAL_PROTOCOL_RULES.COMPLETE_RACE_RULE: REOPEN and COMPLETE contend in the same Mission Fence STATE_VERSION CAS domain. REOPEN-first invalidates stale COMPLETE; COMPLETE-first rejects admission of the membership change into the completed closure generation.
CANONICAL_PROTOCOL_RULES.PIN_BINDING: Pinned closure authority binds immutable shard-freeze manifest, MEMBERSHIP_ROOT_HASH, DRAIN_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH, CLOSURE_GENERATION, MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH and all other clause [209] pinned-world components in canonical closure binding evidence.
CANONICAL_PROTOCOL_RULES.EMPTY_SHARDS: All logical shards in SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH participate, including explicit empty shards.
CANONICAL_PROTOCOL_RULES.REOPEN_GATE_RULE: REOPEN_REQUIRED invalidates the active closure pin only. It does not reopen WORK_ADMISSION_GATE, MUTATION_GATE or INTEGRATION_GATE for normal product engineering.
CANONICAL_PROTOCOL_RULES.USER_STOP_PREEMPTION: USER_STOP [164]-[168] preempts closure membership formation, shard freeze, pinned-world sweeps, REOPEN and COMPLETE. Closure protocol may never delay STOP authority.
CANONICAL_PROTOCOL_RULES.CRASH_RULE: Ambiguous or mismatched shard/fence/pinned-world state fails closed to REOPEN_REQUIRED or reconciliation; absence of observed late writes is never proof of atomic freeze.
CANONICAL_PROTOCOL_RULES.TORTURE_TEST_OBLIGATION: The V2 repair torture-test set is mandatory before VERIFIED_GLOBAL_CODE_CLOSURE and remains unsatisfied until real execution evidence exists.

PROHIBITED_INTERPRETATIONS: No non-membership observer namespace may bypass clause [217].
No post-pin normal membership write may commit under the old closure pin without prior Mission Fence REOPEN.
No acknowledgement-only shard freeze is authoritative unless backed by the shard CAS result.
No Mission Fence STATE_VERSION check alone may substitute for membership record generation CAS or shard freeze CAS.
This binding does not imply V16 atomic activation, product mutation authority, integration authority, test PASS or global closure.
GENESIS_REQUIREMENT: If V16-RC1.3 later reaches genesis/activation, the canonical mission/control implementation must carry this binding or an independently reviewed semantically equivalent successor before closure functionality may be considered safe.
